title: Nourishing Pillowy Italian Portobello Mushrooms Saltimbocca
description: A peppery, pillowy, vegetarian-friendly Italian dish featuring dry white wine and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a satisfying meal prep solution.

ingredients.name: Portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stem removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat and saute garlic until fragrant.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add dry white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Stir in chopped ferment-kimchi and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Butter one side of each provolone cheese slice.
To assemble the saltimbocca, place a cooked mushroom slice on a flat surface, then top with a sage leaf, a slice of provolone cheese buttered side up, and finally another mushroom slice.
Place the saltimbocca on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
